# Khronos headers

Unmodified headers from the Khronos Group, provided by the user:
- `EGL/egl.h`, `EGL/eglplatform.h` — Copyright The Khronos Group Inc., SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
- `GLES3/gl3.h`, `GLES3/gl32.h`, `GLES3/gl3platform.h` — Copyright The Khronos Group Inc., SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
- `KHR/khrplatform.h` — Copyright The Khronos Group Inc., MIT-style license (text in the header)

Each file keeps its original license header. Only used to compile the OpenGL ES backend.
